sentences.en: Three long-term inmates of the state penitentiary have just escaped.
sentences.zh: 州立监狱里的三名长期服刑人员刚刚越狱。

sentences.en: Many inmates on death row say they want to die.
sentences.zh: 许多死囚表示他们想死。

sentences.en: Inmates were forced to sleep in one cell, often sideways.
sentences.zh: 犯人被迫在一间牢房里睡觉，常常是侧身睡。

senses.zh: (尤指)同院病人；同狱犯人；同被(收容所)收容者
